The Zac Schulze Gang
NewEvents.Description: NIEUWE DATUM / NEW DATE NL: Concert ‘The Zac Schulze Gang’ van 18 juli verplaatst naar woensdag 21 oktober Wegens een blessure is het voor The Zac Schulze Gang onmogelijk om dit weekend op te treden bij 4AD. Samen met de band gingen we op zoek naar een nieuwe datum , en we zijn blij dat we het concert kunnen verplaatsen naar woensdag 21 oktober . Tickets voor dit concert blijven geldig. Komt deze datum je niet uit? Dan kun je een terugbetaling aanvragen. Check je mailbox voor alle info of mail naar stijn@4ad.be. We wensen Zac Schulze een spoedig herstel toe en kijken ernaar uit om hen op 21 oktober te verwelkomen! ENG: The Zac Schulze Gang concert on July 18 postponed to Wednesday, October 21 Due to an injury, The Zac Schulze Gang are unfortunately unable to perform at 4AD this weekend. Together with the band, we’ve found a new date , and we’re happy to announce that the concert has been rescheduled to Wednesday, October 21 . All tickets remain valid for the new date. If you’re unable to attend on October 21, you can request a refund. Please check your inbox for all the details, or contact us at stijn@4ad.be. We wish Zac Schulze a speedy recovery and look forward to welcoming the band to 4AD on October 21! The Zac Schulze Gang (vk) Brits powertrio komt debuutplaat ‘Straight to It’ demonstreren. De met blues geïnfecteerde rock-’n-roll van The Zac Schulze Gang komt je helemaal van je sokken blazen. Frontman en gitarist Zac Schulze is een virtuoos toptalent zoals je dat maar zelden meemaakt, maar het is bovenal de collectieve energie van de ‘gang’ die de band zo geweldig maakt. Met zijn broer Ben Schulze op drums en Ant Greenwell op bas brengen ze een stevige wall of sound, opgebouwd uit punk, funk, country, jazz, soul, metal en pop. Het trio deed eerst de nodige ervaring op in het punkcircuit van het Verenigd Koninkrijk. Tijdens de infameuze coronapandemie botste Zac op een YouTube-clip van Rory Gallagher : een openbaring die de richting van de band definitief bepaalde. Na heel wat extra live-kilometers kwam de doorbraak er tijdens het -zeer toepasselijke- Rory Gallagher Tribute Festival in 2022, een set die hen snel tot een vaste waarde katapulteerde binnen de Britse bluesscene. Sindsdien groeiden ze uit tot ware road warriors, met meer dan 250 optredens per jaar en tours door heel Europa. Hun toewijding zorgde ervoor dat de band in 2024 de UK Blues Awards voor Best Emerging Blues Band won. In 2025 verscheen de eerste volwaardige debuutplaat ‘Straight to It’ , een gevarieerde en energieke plaat die de toon zet voor wat je live mag verwachten: tonnen energie en muzikaal vakmanschap. Rock-’n-roll leeft, en hoe! Facebook | Instagram

NewEvents.Title: REHAB - ROOFTOP SESSION #3 (GEANNULEERD)
NewEvents.Description: REHAB ROOFTOP SESSION #3Rehab is back with the 3rd drum and bass rooftop session on top of Wilde Westen!Good vibes, quality soundsystem and great line-up for a perfect closing of your summer. FD (The North Quarter, UK)Developing a love for music through London’s pirate radio waves and the energy of the city’s rave scene, FD’s journey has always been one driven by feeling. Those early days spent recording mix tapes and chasing the emotionof certain records naturally led towards DJing and soon after the need tocreate his own music followed.As a DJ, FD’s sets are journeys built from a long-standing love andunderstanding of the music, showcasing the full spectrum of drum & bass, inall it’s depth, emotion and versatility, revealing how its tempo can carry aworld of ideas and influences. Having played at some of the scene’s mostrespected clubs and festivals around the world, he continues to represent hisown vision and belief in what makes this music truly special. Redeyes (Five Alley, The North Quarter, FR)Redeyes is a versatile producer from Toulouse, known for his soulful and genre-blending music.His work spans across Drum & Bass, Hip-Hop, Jazz, Soul, Funk, and House, creating a rich and diverse soundscape.A prominent artist on The North Quarter label,Redeyes has released acclaimed albums like“Broken Soul” in 2018 and “Selfportraits” in 2020. These works highlight his ability to seamlessly navigate different genres and tempos, showcasing his detailed and soulful production style! One87This DJ, producer, and promoter is a true pioneer of the Belgian drum & bass scene. As the mastermind behind the legendary Star Warz nights in Ghent, he is a champion of innovative sounds and shapes the culture.In close collaboration with Rampage, he hosts an annual stage where he curates the line-up. With releases on Critical, Dispatch & Flexout Audio, expect nothing less than deep, dark & rolling energy when he steps up! Respect The BreakzA drum and bass collective that includes Try One, Split Personality & VIKI is ready to conquer Kortrijk! With their own experience behind the decks, they decided to collaborate as a trio to show their knowledge. Sisley & BenOneShotSisley & BenOneShot are a must-see duo on the Belgian Drum and Bass scene. This explosive tandem is known for their powerful and energetic sets, capable of electrifying any crowd. Their unique style spans from jungle to “dancefloor killers”, “rolling steppers” and soulful drum and bass, always seeking out the rhythms that make people move.Regularly featured at the biggest Drum and Bass events in Belgium, they’ve made their mark at Dour, Tomorrowland and Starwarz, to name just a few. With a perfect blend of musicality and raw energy, their performances strike a delicate balance between power and harmony. Each performance is a thrilling journey, with seamless transitions and a high energy atmosphere.Whether on international or local stages, Sisley & BenOneShot know how to captivate their audience. Get ready, because every set is a wild ride you won’t want to miss! MDRLRMDRLR (also known as Madruler) is an Antwerp-based DJ, producer, and promoter who has been a staple of the Belgian electronic music underground for over three decades. He is most recognized for his dedication to atmospheric jungle, drumfunk, and deep, soulful drum & bass. Swift (NL)Every now and then you come across an MC who actually complements the music, Swift is certainly one of them. With his distinctive voice Swift brings something extra to the table. Swift is mostly known as a Drum and bass & Dubstep MC, but he actually fits any type of bassheavy music.Hailing from the urban jungle that is Rotterdam, Swift unexpectedly became one of Holland's most prolific MC's. Starting as an MC by accident, from the first second he picked up a mic there was no denying his talent. MC NiceBeing the host MC at some of the biggest stages and festivals, MC NIice has become one of the leading voices of the bass-music scene in Belgium. With his short bars and hyper lyrics, Nice adds pure energy to the sound! Inspired by some old school Renegade Hardware mix-tapes, he started writing lyrics around the millennium years. + Residents: Twogun & Likewize
